description:
Find code nothing runs: functions no production entry point (endpoint, CLI command, cron job, event handler, worker, entry file) reaches. Pass `functions` to check whether specific functions are wired in.

CALL THIS WHEN:
• Before cleaning up a module or deleting a function
• After merging new code, to confirm an entry point reaches it

RETURNS:
• Dead: unreached, named in no other file, and no production file imports its file. Safe to delete.
• Possibly unused: unreached, but named in other files (string dispatch, dynamic loading) or its file is imported. Listed with the files that name it; check before deleting.
• Used only by tests: exported functions and class methods only test files reference.
With `functions`: each one's status, and the call path from an entry point when it's reachable.

USE INSTEAD OF: searching for references to decide whether code is dead. No references doesn't mean unreached, and a reference doesn't mean it runs.

functions.description: Function names to check instead of listing everything unused

repo.description: Repository name — one of your connected repos.

name: get_unused_code
